# Business Internet Quotes

> Business Internet Quotes (businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com) is a free service that finds business-grade internet service providers available at a specific commercial address. A business submits its legal name, service address, and contact details once; we check the business-grade ISPs serviceable at that exact address and return quotes — including monthly cost, install timeline, hardware fees, and contract length. The service is free to the business; carriers pay a referral commission when a business signs service. We are not a carrier or reseller and do not sell submitted information.

Full page content for language models: https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/llms-full.txt

## How it works

1. The business submits one form: legal business name, service address, and contact details.
2. We check which business-grade carriers are serviceable at that exact address (coverage is address-specific, not zip-code-specific).
3. The business receives quotes with the four numbers that matter: monthly cost, install timeline, hardware fees, and contract length.
4. No cost and no obligation to the business at any point; carriers pay a referral commission only when a business signs service.

## Agent access

- MCP server (read-only, no auth, same-site): https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/mcp with tools get_overview, list_faqs, search_faqs.
- FAQ API: https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/api/faq
- Markdown content negotiation: request any content page with `Accept: text/markdown` for a clean markdown version.
- Crawl policy: AI crawlers are welcome for search and real-time answering; content is not licensed for training. See https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/robots.txt
- The quote form itself is deliberately not exposed to agents (it collects business PII); a human submits it at the site.

## Facts

- Service area: United States (quotes are address-specific to a commercial location).
- Cost to the business: free, no obligation.
- Business-grade focus: symmetrical speeds, SLAs, static IPs, dedicated lines — not residential service.
- Contact: quotes@businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com
- Part of the sdfkjh.com family of hand-built sites: https://sdfkjh.com/api/sites
